name: The Digital Library of Middle East

content.title: The Digital Library of Middle East
content.summary: The IIS-ISMC Library's lecture on the initiative aiming to preserve cultural heritage from the Middle East.

media.caption: A picture of Dr Charles Henry, Dr Peter Herdrich and Dr Walid Ghali during the lecture
media.alt: The Digital Library of Middle East

content.text: The IIS-ISMC Library organised a public lecture about the newly established initiative aiming to preserve cultural heritage from the Middle East. The lecture was coordinated by Dr Walid Ghali, the Head Librarian and was delivered by Dr Charles Henry, president of Council on Library and Information Resources, and Dr Peter Herdrich, co-founder of The Antiquities Coalition.

Peter Herdrich said, "The DLME can only be successful if it attracts the finest institutional partners to collaboratively develop its architecture and content. We are delighted to work with the Aga Khan University as emblematic of a partnership of exemplary insight and wisdom, recognised and deeply respected both in the MENA region and globally."

He also emphasised on the significance of their presentation for the DLME and the success that has resulted from this event; they were able to introduce their project to so many of their colleagues in the British community and reach a worldwide audience via the webcast.
